common.helpBoth: If you need anything, write to {email} or call {phone}.
common.helpEmail: If you need anything, write to {email}.
common.reason: You are receiving this email because you made a booking with {brand}.
common.staffReason: Internal email sent to the company's contact address.

bookingReceived.subject: Your places are held · {code}
bookingReceived.heading: Your places are being held
bookingReceived.intro: Thank you for choosing {tour}. We are holding places for your party.
bookingReceived.hold: They are held until {time} (Vietnam time). Please complete the payment of {amount} before then to confirm your journey.
bookingReceived.holdNoTime: Please complete the payment of {amount} to confirm your journey.
bookingReceived.lapse: If the hold ends before your payment reaches us, the places are released to other travellers. You are welcome to book again at any time.

paymentReceived.subject: Payment received · {code}
paymentReceived.preview: We have received a payment for {code}.
paymentReceived.heading: Thank you for your payment
paymentReceived.introNoAmount: We have received a payment for booking {code}.
paymentReceived.flagged: Our team will review this payment and be in touch with you shortly.

bookingConfirmed.subject: Your journey is confirmed · {code}
bookingConfirmed.heading: Your journey is confirmed
bookingConfirmed.intro: Booking {code} for {tour} is confirmed. We look forward to welcoming you.
bookingConfirmed.balance: The balance of {amount} is due by {date}. We will send you a reminder before then.
bookingConfirmed.next: Before departure, we will be in touch to complete the traveller details and send your detailed itinerary.

paymentLink.subject: A payment link for your journey · {code}
paymentLink.heading: Your journey is ready
paymentLink.intro: {tour} (booking {code}) has been prepared as we discussed.

kind.deposit: A deposit of {amount} holds your places and confirms the journey.
kind.full: A payment in full of {amount} holds your places and confirms the journey.
kind.balance: This is the balance of {amount} for your journey.

paymentLink.expiry: The link works once and expires at {time} (Vietnam time).
paymentLink.private: This link is for you alone. Please do not forward this email.

balanceReminder.subject: A reminder about your balance · {code}
balanceReminder.preview: The balance for booking {code} is due soon.
balanceReminder.heading: Your journey is drawing near
balanceReminder.intro: The balance of {amount} for booking {code} is due by {date}.
balanceReminder.introNoDate: The balance of {amount} for booking {code} is awaiting payment.
balanceReminder.ignore: If you have just paid, please disregard this email.

bookingCancelled.subject: Your booking has been cancelled · {code}
bookingCancelled.heading: Your booking has been cancelled
bookingCancelled.refund: For the amount you have paid, we will be in touch about a refund under the cancellation policy that applied when you booked.
bookingCancelled.farewell: We hope to travel with you on another journey.
